_comment: Vocabulary for classifying a question about a selected workbook as structural (answered from TabularInventory alone) or a data-analysis operation (computed by tabular::engine, no model call either way). Data, never literals in Rust (docs/DECISIONS.md). A sheet or column name is never guessed from this list - it is matched against the workbook's own real names, in tabular/question.rs.

column_names._comment: Words inside a column's own name. Read from every pack at once, whatever the interface language, because a workbook's headers are in whatever language it was exported in. 'measures' marks a column worth totalling; 'not_measures' a number that is not an amount (a year, an identifier, a code). Used only to choose which column to total when a question does not name one.
